question: Can one fixed independent signed motor perturbation at a known synchronous first-action state provide nondegenerate local action tags and causally alter first motor threshold timing?
why_next: A10 centered motor participation vanished when all 32 motors fired once. The original exploration pulse was shared and positive; the missing sign information may be an exploration-design problem rather than absent motor controllability.
hypotheses: H3: sign information unavailable under shared exploration
H4: motor perturbation tags exist but cannot alter first-action timing

state.selection_rule: Previously documented global pulse immediately before the A8.2 outcome-373 null first DOWN; no new state selection

intervention.sign_stream: For each motor ID j independently, use low bit of SHA256('A11|2002|373|371324000|' + decimal(j)); 0 maps -1, 1 maps +1. One locked realization, no redraw or selection.
intervention.inverse: Negate each sign of the one locked realization; antithetic comparison, not a second searched stream.
intervention.no_pulse: Override only the motor drive on this known exploration tick to zero.
intervention.shared: Unchanged +20 motor drive on the known exploration tick.
intervention.signed: Replace only the motor drive on that tick with 20 times the locked sign for each motor ID.
intervention.after_intervention: Set exploration probability to zero and plasticity_enabled=false identically in all branches; preserve fixed game, encoder, graph and readout. Continue only until outcome 373 resolves. No update or new training.

local_tag.at_pulse: q_ij(t_pulse)=pre_trace_i(t_pulse)*sign_j for all 480 selected relay-to-motor slots; no-pulse q=0, shared q uses sign_j=+1
local_tag.at_first_down: q_ij(t_first)=q_ij(t_pulse)*exp(-(t_first-t_pulse)/existing_tau_eligibility_us); immutable action record if first DOWN occurs
local_tag.causal_boundary: Only pre-pulse presynaptic state, injected sign and first action time are used. No game target time or future judgement enters the tag. No weights are updated.

controls: Exact same pre-pulse checkpoint, RNG, sensory input, topology, weights, neural queues, eligibility, predictor, readout, game and note. All branches consume the same original Bernoulli draw; only motor drive on that tick differs. Post-tick exploration and plasticity are frozen identically.
primary_endpoints: both signs among nonzero action tags in locked_signed and inverse
signed per-cell motor response contrast within 20 ms
first motor on-threshold rise in locked_signed versus inverse

predeclared_interpretation.pass: Both signed branches have a first DOWN; each action-tag vector has both positive and negative nonzero entries; signed 20-ms motor response dot product sum_j sign_j*(count_signed_j-count_inverse_j) is positive; and first on-threshold rise times differ by at least one 1000-us tick without silence.
predeclared_interpretation.fail: Either signed action-tag vector lacks both signs, or the signed 20-ms motor response dot product is nonpositive despite an auditable pulse.
predeclared_interpretation.inconclusive: Signs and motor response are present but first threshold times are identical, one branch has no first action/crossing, or a nonlinear action switch prevents timing interpretation.
predeclared_interpretation.scope: One state and one fixed sign realization; no learning-rule validation, no across-seed claim, no M2 pass.

prohibitions: no sign seed or amplitude search
no ideal press time to neural code
stop after audit, regression and report
